prompt: Which statements about GitHub Marketplace are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Marketplace aggregates third-party (and some first-party) apps and Actions, installable at repository or organization scope. Most of the catalog is community-built, and browsing needs no enterprise plan.

options.text: It lists GitHub Apps and Actions
Listings can be installed for a repository or an organization
Listings cover categories like CI, code review, and security
Everything in Marketplace is built and operated by GitHub itself
